params.description: What was sent, so a dry run has something to show and a real call can be reproduced

response.description: Exactly what the site returned, unread. This is the one field in the contract whose shape belongs to the site and not to this project: there is no typed contract for an arbitrary function, and inventing one would be a promise that cannot be kept. Null for a dry run.

mutates.description: What was known about the function before calling it

needs_allow_write.description: A real run of this call would be refused without --allow-write. Always false outside a plan.
